skill_friction: SKILL.md step 5 lists 'which same-label field is meant' as an ask trigger; here 'date' could mean Order_Date__c or CreatedDate, but data shape (identical CreatedDate on all rows) settled it. The skill does not say whether data shape counts as 'the org's semantics' that answers intent; I treated it as such and did not ask.

design-rules says 'update the layout only if it is still used' but record page activation/assignment is unreadable with the allowed commands; the skill gives no default for this common case, so I made the layout row Conditional.

Removing an existing column (Comments__c) from a shared layout related list sits between 'change that alters behavior for other users' (ask) and 'the requirement asks for it' (decide); the skill does not say whether a column list in the requirement is exclusive.

The 'two wrong AskCoworker claims' threshold was crossed only at R (Reason__c, page size 6), after D2 facts were already used; the skill does not say whether to retroactively re-verify earlier kept facts (I verified all kept facts except trigger/flow absence, which the design does not depend on).
AskCoworker labels echoes of my own facts as 'prior session'; the rule handles this, but it inflates the untraceable-fact noise in every call.
